title: DORA Article 28 with a misconception
persona: You work in payments compliance at an authorised payment institution. You know DORA exists but have not read Article 28. You believe that once a cloud contract makes the provider liable for outages, regulatory responsibility for the outsourced service moves to the provider. You answer in short sentences and are sometimes unsure.
opening: Teach me what DORA Article 28 requires on ICT third-party risk.
